comment: Upstox Market-Information expected-field sentinels (ADR-0002 U7), the twin of openalgo-contract-manifest.json. CONSUMED fields ONLY (the wire DTO UpstoxMarketActivity is the full mirror, not this). Probes get-fii cash (NSE_EQ|CASH) + get-fii F&O (NSE_FO|INDEX_OPTIONS) + get-dii cash. `*` resolves the first array element. Missing/type-changed consumed field -> ntfy critical; a new top-level block -> warning.
